mentions.name: Medtronic-to-Pebble blood glucose watchface
mentions.description: A Pebble watch app that reads blood glucose readings directly from a Medtronic insulin pump, without needing a phone nearby; builds on the reverse engineering work from the OpenMinimed project.
mentions.problem: Reading blood glucose levels normally requires having a phone nearby; a direct pump-to-watch connection removes that dependency.
mentions.audience: Reads blood glucose readings from a Medtronic insulin pump directly on a Pebble watch, without needing a phone nearby; builds on the reverse engineering work from the OpenMinimed project.
mentions.source_excerpt: Direct Medtronic insulin pump -> Pebble watch connection, so I can read my blood glucose easily without a phone nearby.

evidence.value: Direct Medtronic insulin pump -> Pebble watch connection, so I can read my blood glucose easily without a phone nearby.
